core_problem_being_solved: state['citations'] is built deterministically from real source IDs, but the report's References section and in-text [N] markers are written independently by the LLM with zero code-level connection - a citation can reference an ID never in that run's tool results and nothing catches it. Phase 5's Evidence object makes closing this structurally possible for later phases; Phase 5 itself does not touch report generation.

input.optional_input: orchestration call_id from tool_call_history (agent/nodes.py) when available - must be threaded through, not replaced with a new ID scheme

evidence_id_scheme.rule: deterministic, source-namespaced, never randomly generated when stable source identity exists; no Evidence record created for a no_match/ambiguous_match resolve_compound_name result (no real ID exists)

source_faithful_content_rule: content must be verbatim source text OR a deterministic representation of a structured field - never an LLM paraphrase. Raw and normalized values both retained where Phase 5 introduces normalization.

source_url_generation.rule: deterministic from verified source_record_id only, never model-generated

no_invented_confidence_rule: retrieval_score preserved only when a real source pipeline produces one, tagged with producing method; never reinterpreted as factual confidence. Follows the resolve_compound_name match_type pattern (deterministic category, not a fabricated float) identified in the audit as the correct existing template.
local_rag_provenance_requirement: every PubMed RAG Evidence record must carry corpus_index_version (from data/index/index_meta.json) alongside chunk_id/chunk_index/num_chunks - never only a FAISS row position. Does not resolve Phase 4's documented corpus-reproducibility gap.
structured_field_path_rule: field_path recorded only when the parser's own field-access path is fixed and verifiable against actual code; left absent (not guessed) when the parser derives/joins a value without one fixed source path.
